skill.name: bodhi-sdk-react-integration
skill.description: Guide React and Vite projects through bodhi-js-sdk integration for local LLM chat, OAuth setup, GitHub Pages deployment, and troubleshooting.
skill.summary: Integrates React and Vite apps with bodhi-js-sdk for local LLM chat and OAuth flows.
skill.author: BodhiSearch

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown, TypeScript template literals, documented OAuth URLs, and public Vite configuration. No prompt injection evidence was found. One semantic issue remains: troubleshooting examples can expose OAuth tokens through full auth-state and localStorage logging.

remediation.issue: OAuth token state is exposed in troubleshooting examples.
remediation.suggestion: Replace full auth and localStorage logging with redacted status fields. Never print access tokens, refresh tokens, or complete auth state.

remediation.issue: Debug log sharing can include sensitive browser state.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users to redact tokens, auth state, localStorage values, and account identifiers before sharing console logs.

remediation.issue: Environment examples could be mistaken for secret storage guidance.
remediation.suggestion: State that Vite variables are public browser configuration and must not contain private secrets.

content.user_title: Integrate Bodhi SDK with React Apps
content.value_statement: React teams need a clear path from a Vite app to local LLM chat. This skill provides Bodhi SDK setup, OAuth guidance, deployment notes, and troubleshooting steps.
actual_capabilities: Guides installation of the Bodhi React package in React and Vite projects.
Shows how to wrap an app with BodhiProvider and configure OAuth client settings.
Provides chat, model loading, streaming, and non-streaming response patterns.
Explains GitHub Pages base paths, callback paths, and SPA redirect handling.
Troubleshoots extension mode, direct mode, authentication, model loading, and API failures.
limitations: Focuses on React and Vite projects, not every frontend framework.
Requires a running Bodhi backend and user-managed OAuth client registration.
Uses examples and placeholders; it does not create OAuth clients automatically.
Does not replace review of production authentication and deployment settings.

use_cases.title: Add Local LLM Chat
use_cases.description: Add Bodhi-powered chat to a React and Vite application with streaming responses and model selection.

use_cases.title: Configure OAuth Environments
use_cases.description: Set development and production OAuth client IDs, auth servers, and redirect URIs for Bodhi authentication.

use_cases.title: Deploy to GitHub Pages
use_cases.description: Prepare base path settings, callback routes, and static hosting behavior for a Bodhi-enabled app.

prompt_templates.title: Begin Basic Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: First integration in an existing React and Vite app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add Bodhi SDK support to my React and Vite app. Show the package install, provider setup, and a simple test checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Chat Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a usable chat interface after provider setup.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Bodhi chat component that loads models, checks authentication, sends prompts, and streams responses into the UI.

prompt_templates.title: Configure OAuth Deployment
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare separate development and production authentication settings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Bodhi OAuth configuration for development and production. Check client IDs, auth servers, redirect URIs, and callback paths.

prompt_templates.title: Harden an Existing Integration
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of a deployed app with auth and deployment issues.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit my existing Bodhi React integration. Find connection, authentication, deployment, logging, and token handling problems.

output_examples.input: I have a Vite app and a Bodhi client ID. I need the fastest working integration.
output_examples.output: A concise setup plan with provider placement, required configuration values, a chat component outline, and a validation checklist.

output_examples.input: My GitHub Pages deployment returns a callback error after OAuth login.
output_examples.output: A focused diagnosis of base path, registered redirect URI, callback path, and static routing behavior.

output_examples.input: Models do not load after I authenticate with Bodhi.
output_examples.output: A troubleshooting path that checks readiness state, backend reachability, downloaded models, and API error messages.

best_practices: Use separate OAuth client IDs for development and production environments.
Verify server readiness and authentication state before calling model or chat APIs.
Redact tokens, auth state, and localStorage values before sharing debug logs.
anti_patterns: Do not treat Vite environment variables as a place for private secrets.
Do not deploy with localhost redirect URIs in production OAuth clients.
Do not log full authentication objects or stored token values during troubleshooting.

faq.question: What projects does this skill support?
faq.answer: It targets React and Vite web apps that use bodhi-js-sdk through the Bodhi React package.

faq.question: Does it create a Bodhi OAuth client for me?
faq.answer: No. It explains the values to register and how to place them in your application.

faq.question: Can it help with GitHub Pages deployments?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers base paths, callback paths, static routing, and OAuth redirect URI alignment.

faq.question: Does it require the Bodhi Browser extension?
faq.answer: No. The guide describes extension mode as preferred and direct mode as a fallback.

faq.question: Can it debug model loading failures?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks authentication, server readiness, downloaded models, and API request errors.

faq.question: Are OAuth client IDs secret?
faq.answer: They are public client identifiers, but access tokens and auth state still need redaction.
